text:
zoe (PM): hey team — resurrecting the Alerting SLO panel convo with a slightly different approach: compact notification preview, clearer "Silences" copy, and keyboard-first interactions. attaching new figma: https://figma.redwood/alerts/compact-preview
hugo (Design): nice direction. idea: reduce horizontal noise by collapsing channel pills into a single compact strip. show up to two channels inline, then a small chevron button that expands an overlay list (no layout shift). overlay includes type icons (📧, 💬, 🔔) and a small "simulate" CTA per channel.
felix (Frontend): overlay is fine but avoid heavy DOM for every change. we'll render the overlay lazily on first open. for inline strip: use svg avatars + fallback initials. also suggest debouncing the preview render by 350ms.
zoe (PM): question on the chevron trigger wording — should it say "+N channels" or "Show channels"? product prefers explicit counts so users know how many recipients exist.
hugo (Design): prefer "+N channels" for compactness; ensure tooltip reads "Show N channels" for screen readers. the chevron should be a proper button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
anya (A11y): accessible checklist: 1) chevron must be reachable via keyboard and announce "Show N channels, button". 2) overlay should be a dialog role=menu or role=listbox? If it's just a list of destinations, role=menu with menuitems works. Ensure focus traps to the overlay and ESC closes. 3) pills must have 4.5:1 contrast and visible focus ring.
felix (Frontend): on keyboard: Tab to the chevron, press Enter to open overlay, arrow keys navigate channels, Enter toggles selection detail (like simulate). we'll implement roving tabindex for menuitems.
hugo (Design): copy change: across the panel replace "suppression" with "Silences" and add helper line: "Silences stop outgoing notifications but keep the alert open for auditing." shorter microcopy for the toggle label: "Silence notifications".
zoe (PM): +1. product also wants severity presets (Info/Warn/Critical) mapped to default pXX thresholds but editable inline. if edited, show a subtle pill "custom" and a toast: "You edited this threshold — it no longer follows 'Critical'. Undo".
felix (Frontend): backend contract: persist both fields so we know whether to display preset badge. API shape we prefer to send is a flat object like: `preset_id=critical_v3` and `threshold_override=p95>1.6s`. we'll coordinate with API owners.
anya (A11y): when switching from preset to custom via keyboard, focus should be moved to the threshold input and an aria-live polite message should say "Editing custom threshold". also the toast must be focusable and dismissible via keyboard.
hugo (Design): visual affordance for override: tiny "custom" badge next to the preset chip and tooltip explaining: "This threshold was edited and won't update with preset changes." Also when user types a new custom value show inline undo link for 6 seconds.
preview-bot: generated snapshot: https://images.redwood/preview/1771234567-01.png :camera_with_flash:
felix (Frontend): one perf callout: the incident timeline (open/close events) is expensive to compute for arbitrary time windows. Recommend we ship with a static example timeline and a badge "Live timeline (alpha)" for future work. avoids backend cost now.
zoe (PM): sounds good. final checklist for this ship iteration:
- [ ] compact channel strip + overlay (hugo + felix)
- [ ] simulate per-channel preview in overlay (felix)
- [ ] "Silence notifications" copy + helper text (hugo)
- [ ] preset + custom UX and undo toast (hugo + felix)
- [ ] a11y focus/aria behaviours and contrast checks (anya)
- [ ] static timeline + live badge (felix)

hugo (Design): I'll update the figma with the overlay behaviour, add the custom badge, and wire the toast flows. tagging @preview-bot when done so we can get diffs.
anya (A11y): quick reminder: test with VoiceOver and NVDA on the overlay and the toast. also keyboard-only users should be able to reach the simulate button.
zoe (PM): thanks all — design review Friday EOD. post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
